Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle are popular alternatives to Stripe for selling digital products, but they have significant limitations. Gumroad, for example, charges a 3.5% transaction fee, while Lemon Squeezy offers a 2.9% + 30¢ per transaction fee. Paddle's fees range from 2.9% + 30¢ to 5% + 30¢, depending on the payment method. In contrast, NOWPayments offers a flat 0.5% fee, making it a more cost-effective option for creators in restricted countries. Additionally, each of these platforms has its own set of rules and restrictions, which can impact your ability to sell certain types of digital products.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Many popular payment processors, including Stripe, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy, have strict rules around countries they serve. This means that creators in restricted countries are often forced to rely on alternative payment methods that come with higher fees or fewer features. In contrast, NOWPayments operates on a decentralized network, allowing creators to accept payments from anywhere in the world without restrictions. Furthermore, NOWPayments integrates with a range of cryptocurrencies, providing creators with greater flexibility and autonomy over their payment processing.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment speed, fees, and real costs are critical considerations for creators selling digital products. Gumroad's 3.5% transaction fee, for example, may seem low at first glance, but when combined with the cost of payment processing, it can add up quickly. NOWPayments' flat 0.5% fee, on the other hand, provides creators with greater visibility into their costs and allows them to keep more of their revenue. Additionally, NOWPayments' use of blockchain technology enables fast and secure payment processing, reducing the risk of chargebacks and disputes.
NowPayments is the only payment processor that operates on a decentralized network, enabling creators to accept payments from anywhere in the world without restrictions.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

When it comes to ownership, automation, and delivery, NOWPayments stands out from the competition. By using a decentralized network and blockchain technology, creators maintain full ownership and control over their digital products and payment processing. NOWPayments also integrates with a range of tools and services, enabling creators to automate their payment processing and delivery. This means that creators can focus on what matters most – producing high-quality digital products and engaging with their customers.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Ultimately, the choice of payment processor depends on your specific situation and needs. If you're looking for a cost-effective option with minimal fees, NOWPayments may be the best choice. If you're willing to pay a premium for additional features and support, Gumroad or Lemon Squeezy may be a better option. Regardless of which option you choose, it's essential to carefully review the terms and conditions, fees, and payment processing rules to ensure that you're making an informed decision.
